exampleTranslation: He goes by motorbike. / He goes by car.

back: the three main verbs used with transport expressions

exampleTranslation: One travels/goes/comes by boat.

back: au: au Ghana, au Togo, au Sénégal

exampleTranslation: My father is a customs officer. He works between Ghana and Togo.

exampleTranslation: The professors will leave for the United States after the exam.

exampleTranslation: They will leave for the United States.

exampleTranslation: Madam wants meat. So she goes to the butcher's.

back: à + le = au; à + les = aux; à + la = à la; à + l' = à l'

exampleTranslation: Samuel has a bad stomach ache.

back: through/via — used for passing through a place

exampleTranslation: Travelling from Accra to Paris, we passed through Casablanca.

back: across/through (a space, not a stop-over city)

exampleTranslation: They travelled across the desert.

exampleTranslation: There are many sharp objects on the site.

exampleTranslation: He works between Ghana and Togo.

example: L'ingénieur travaille avec ses collègues sur le chantier.
exampleTranslation: The engineer works with his colleagues on the site.

back: au/à la/à l'/aux + body part = to have pain there

exampleTranslation: Samuel has a stomach ache. / The young lady has a toothache.

back: to go to see a professional (doctor, dentist, baker...)

exampleTranslation: She goes to the dentist to get treated.

exampleTranslation: This engineer works at TULLOW.

front: des lunettes de sécurité / de protection

exampleTranslation: As an engineer, you must wear safety glasses before starting work.

exampleTranslation: They are worn to protect the hand and fingers.

exampleTranslation: You must wear safety boots to protect your feet.

example: Le bouchon d'oreille sert à protéger l'oreille.
exampleTranslation: The earplug protects the ear.

example: Une scie circulaire sert à couper le bois.
